Name: Satoru Gojo NPC Jujutsu Kaisen
Author: cursedcure
Description:
[quote]﻿Hello everyone!

I apologize for my inactivity. I'm trying to handle my life the best I can right now and going back to modding will only stress me further. If anyone is interested in editing or expanding this mod, you have my permission to upload it as a new mod on Nexus. For those who want to permission for this page for editing, please add my second Discord account @cursedcure and we can talk there when I see it.

Thank you for your understanding and all the love <3[/quote]

Hello!
This is my [b]first time[/b] making a mod so it's not perfect. I don't know how to do heart events so he has none. There's some weird bugs, he disappears during Luau and Jellyfish festival when the event starts.

You can[b] marry him[/b], have kids, adopted or not.
I will most likely add him to on every festival, on next update. (If it's not bug fixes)

[i][img]https://i.imgur.com/57JW4Rq.png[/img]
[/i][b]2.0.5[/b]
[list]
[*]Added compatibility with SDV 1.6.8 and 1.6.9+
[*]Requires Content Patcher 2.3.0 or higher
[*]Fixed spouse room and spouse patio loading errors
[*]Fixed broken dialogue lines
[*]Fixed missing sleep animation
[*]Fixed not appearing in year 2 festivals
[*]Fixed vanishing from festivals after events start
[*]Changed some festival positions
[*]Changed festival attendance (attends all festivals except the Stardew Valley Fair)
[*]Added marriage schedule
[*]Added schedule for passive festivals added in 1.6

[/list][b]2.0.4[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed so when he's in the resort, the portrait changes with his beach outfit
[/list][b]2.0.3[/b]
[list]

[/list][b]2.0.2
[/b][list]
[*]Fixed so he doesn't clip in Penny when he's in the Archelogy House
[*]Fixed a dialogue that had wrong portrait emote
[/list][b]2.0.1[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed so farmer isn't stuck in a bush during second heart event
[/list][left][b]2.0.0[/b][/left][list]
[*]Added heart events!
[*]Added so you can dance with him on the flower dance
[*]Changed/Added some broken dialogues

[*]Added a special face if you give him something he hates, suggested by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/117003023]aizuiie[/url] ;)
[/list]

[*]

[list]
[*][b]PS, You can still see every event if you already are married to him and missed them[/b]
[/list]
[quote][b]1 Heart event[/b]
Time: 12:00 PM to 7:00 PM
Location: Archaeology House/Museum
Visit on a Monday, Saturday or Sunday
Not a festival day
------
[code][spoiler][list]
[*]If I find anything, I can let you know. +50
[*]That sounds stupid, you should go back home. -50
[/list][/spoiler]
[/code][/quote]
[quote][b]2 Hearts event
[/b]Time: 12:00 PM to 7:00 PM
Location: Forest (Where the Wizard lives)
Visit forest on a Thursday or Friday
(Drew the special tiles myself ;))
﻿Not a festival day
------
[code][spoiler][list]
[*]Run -10 (ends event)
[*]Go over there. (continues the event)
[*]I'm curious about your training. Mind if I watch? +50
[*]I didn't realize you needed to train so intensely just to keep up, you must be pretty weak. -25
[*]I didn't mean to disturb you. +10
[/list][/spoiler]
[/code][/quote]
[quote][b]4 Hearts event
[/b]Time: 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM
Location: Town
Visit during a sunny summer on a Monday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday or Sunday
﻿Not a festival day
------
[code][spoiler][list]
[*]Yes please, thank you! +50
[*]No, but thank you! +25
[*]Why are you always trying to buy my affection? I don't need your charity. -100
[/list][/spoiler]
[/code][/quote]
[quote][b]6 Hearts event - part 1
[/b]Time: 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM
Location: Farm
On a Friday
﻿Not a festival day

[b]6 Hearts event - part 2
[/b]Time: 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM
Location: Bus stop
On a Sunday
﻿Not a festival day
------
[code][spoiler][list]
[*]Yes, I am! (continues event)
[*]I actually don't want to hang out with you... Goodbye. -50 (ends event)
[*]Such troublemakers! Hahaha. +50
[*]What a stupid and childish story... -25
[*]Thanks for inviting me here! +10
[*]Do you come here often?
[/list][/spoiler]
[/code][/quote]

[/b](You're dating him)
Time: 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM
Location: Farm
On a sunny day
﻿Not a festival day
------
[code][spoiler][list]

[/list][/spoiler]
